text:
Escalating: the bead's "member queries the same Space; response includes the full object" test requires the handler to distinguish a member caller from a non-member caller. The handler determines membership via JmapBackend::principal_id(caller) compared against Space.members.

Workspace seam state (per workspace AGENTS.md "Caller identity (foundation seam)"):
- JmapBackend::principal_id has a sync default returning None
- principal_id signature is fn principal_id(caller: &Self::CallerCtx) -> Option<&Id> — depends only on the caller-context value, not on backend state
- MemoryBackend sets CallerCtx = () and inherits the default, so principal_id always returns None
- All existing TrackingBackend tests also use CallerCtx = ()

Consequence: with the current seam state, every caller in chat-server tests is a non-member. The bead's member-positive test as written cannot pass without an architectural change.

Three workable paths, each carries scope beyond a single Layer A bead — please pick one:

1. Richer CallerCtx for tests. Change TrackingBackend's CallerCtx from () to a small TestCallerCtx { principal_id: Option<Id> }, override principal_id to read it. Touches the entire forwarding boilerplate plus tests/common/mod.rs. ~50-100 LOC. Non-breaking for production crates (MemoryBackend retains ()).

2. Configurable test-time principal_id on MemoryBackend. Add inner.test_principal_id: Mutex<Option<Id>> + set_principal_id_for_test setter, return the configured value from a NEW backend method (NOT principal_id, which is fn-of-arg-not-self). This breaks the seam — principal_id MUST stay a fn of caller-arg per the seam contract. Not recommended.

3. Defer the member-positive test. Implement just the non-member path + the no-filter path; the member-positive test gets filed as a future bead once option 1 or 2 lands, or once a real production backend exists to exercise it. The kit-side projection logic is verifiable from the non-member path alone (positive-existence test for the trim).

Recommendation if you want forward progress fast: option 3, with a sibling bead filed for "TestCallerCtx in tests/common/ + principal_id override" so it can be picked up later.

Releasing the claim. Continuing with the next non-human ready bead per /do-beads loop.
